name: Renewable Microgrid & Battery Storage Balance
description: 72-hour solar generation, diurnal urban load, grid-scale battery storage, and backup thermal dispatch model.

stocks.name: Battery Energy Stored
stocks.description: State of charge in grid-scale lithium-ion storage.

stocks.name: Cumulative CO2 Emissions
stocks.description: Accumulated carbon emissions from backup thermal generation.

parameters.name: Solar Farm Capacity
parameters.description: Peak midday solar photovoltaic nameplate output.

parameters.name: Base Urban Load
parameters.description: Average electrical load before diurnal peak swings.

parameters.name: Max Inverter Power
parameters.description: Maximum charge/discharge power rating of the battery inverter.

parameters.name: Charge Efficiency
parameters.description: Fractional energy retained during battery charging.

auxiliaries.name: Solar Generation
auxiliaries.description: Idealized daylight sinusoidal solar irradiance curve (06:00 to 18:00).

auxiliaries.name: Total Renewable Output
auxiliaries.description: Combined solar and wind power delivered to the microgrid.

auxiliaries.name: Grid Demand
auxiliaries.description: Diurnal urban electrical demand peaking in late afternoon/evening.

auxiliaries.name: Net Renewable Surplus
auxiliaries.description: Instantaneous surplus (positive) or deficit (negative) before storage dispatch.

auxiliaries.name: Backup Thermal Dispatch
auxiliaries.description: Natural gas backup generation required when renewables and battery cannot cover demand.

flows.name: Battery Charging
flows.equation: min(max(0, net_renewable_surplus_mw), max_charge_rate_mw) * roundtrip_efficiency * (1 if battery_charge_mwh < 238 else 0)

flows.name: Battery Discharging
flows.description: Stored energy dispatched during evening/night deficits.

flows.name: Backup Emissions Rate
flows.description: Carbon intensity of thermal backup dispatch (~0.42 tCO2/MWh).

constraints.label: Battery reserve approached minimum safe floor (25 MWh)
Backup thermal peaker plant dispatched above 5 MW

assumptions.statement: Solar generation follows a smooth clear-sky sinusoidal curve without cloud intermittency.
Battery state of charge is protected with a 15 MWh reserve floor to prevent deep-discharge degradation.
